body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Nokia presented its new slim folder type smart phone ''N76'' during CES 2007. It has a hot key to take pictures and users can upload the images directly to the web. They can edit the images on the handset.
Other features include 2.4-inch display, music playback supporting WMA-DRM, microSD card slot, Bluetooth connectivity, 2M camera with x20 digital zoom, and etc.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Nikki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Seo >
